rationale: Lyc. form of ⲣⲟⲉⲓⲥ 'be wakeful, keep watch'; appears here in ϯⲟⲩ-ⲣ̄ⲱⲉ 'the Five Vigils' (line 2) — the disciplinary watches the teacher must establish. Same root underlies ⲛⲓⲁⲛⲟⲩⲣ̄ⲱⲉ 'the (sleepless) Watchers' (lines 22, 25) at cosmic register.

Plural with ⲛⲓ- demonstrative; ⲁⲛⲟⲩⲣ̄ⲱⲉ analyzable as ⲁⲧ-ⲛⲟⲩ-ⲣ̄ⲱⲉ 'unwearying-of-vigil' or as ⲁ-ⲛ̄-ⲟⲩⲣⲉϩ 'those of guard.' Cosmic figures stationed in the Zone, paralleling the Mind of Light in their pattern of being great-yet-constrained-yet-undefiled.
Habitual ⲱⲁ-ϥ- + ϩⲱⲗ/ϩⲉⲗ 'leap, fly up.' Used of the disturbance that 'leaps up' against the mind when the Five Vigils are not established.
Nominalized verbal phrase ϩⲣ̄-ⲫⲟⲣⲉ 'bearing/wearing upon' from Greek φορεῖν. Used in apposition with ⲛ̄ϩⲱⲧⲁⲣⲧⲣ̄ 'the disturbance' as the load that burdens the disturbed mind.

proposed_english: the part of separation / the schism-portion
rationale: ⲡⲁⲥⲉ (Lyc. ⲡⲁϣ 'portion, half') + ⲡⲱⲣⲝ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ('separate forth'). The fallen teacher becomes a vessel of this 'separation-portion' from the Church — the schismatic faction.

Nominalized ⲧⲱⲟⲩⲛ 'rise, depart.' Two distinct uses on this page: (1) line 10 'the rising-up of love away from his hand' (= departure of love); (2) line 16 'who depart on a journey' (verbal use). Preserves the upward/away semantics.
Temporal-conjunctive Lyc. form introducing the protasis of a generalization in line 9. Possibly = ϣⲁⲛⲧⲉ 'until' or a parallel temporal conjunction.

proposed_english: they have contracted them / they have bent them
rationale: Possibly from ⲱⲗⲕ̄ 'wind, bend, fold together' with 3pl object. Used of how the Watchers (great in themselves) have been contracted to fit the cosmic Zone — paralleling the Mind's bending into the body.

From ⲥⲟⲃⲕ̄ 'become small, diminish.' Used three times on this page (lines 26, 28, 29) for the cosmic-anthropological pattern: great beings (Watchers, Mind of Light) shrink/diminish to fit smaller containers (Zone, body).

In ⲡⲱⲓ ⲙ̄ⲡⲍⲱϩ 'that which is of the X' (line 26). Likely Lyc. ⲡϩⲱⲃ 'the work/matter' (cf. ⲡⲍⲱⲃ in glossary), referring to the bodily/cosmic structure into which great beings contract themselves. Confidence moderate.
ⲍⲛ̄- (Lyc. for ϩⲉⲛ- indefinite plural) + ⲛⲁϭ 'great' + ⲙⲉⲛ ('indeed') + ⲛⲉ ('they are'). Standard concessive opening of the contrast 'they are great BUT...'.
ⲣ̄- (do) + ⲙⲉⲥⲧⲉ 'hate' + 3pl object. Standard verbal compound for active hating.
Lyc. plural form of ϣⲃⲏⲣ 'companion, fellow' — appears here as 'his fellows' alongside brothers and beloveds in the triadic relational set.
